scope: Acquired T1-to-T1 adult brain MRI, deterministic image-only registration, shared FlashAlign affine initialization

sample.pair_construction: All unordered subject pairs within each block, one lexicographically oriented registration per pair; evaluate both exported directions. Subjects occur in exactly one block and cohort. Do not count swapping directions as another independent pair.
sample.cohort_independence: P03 verifies independent acquisition provenance and documents processing/annotation dependence; distinct cohort names alone are insufficient.
sample.heldout_rule: Reserve and hash subjects, blocks, pairs, annotations, eligibility and metadata before qualification outcomes. Remove no case after execution begins. Any outcome-informed change consumes the holdout.

preparation.crop: Each native image independently: foreground-mask bounding box in RAS, floor/ceil to spacing and pad 24 mm
preparation.intensity: Mask native intensity, trilinear resample, divide by 99th percentile of positive prepared voxels; reject empty/nonfinite/invalid scale
preparation.mask: Image-only supplied mask with documented provenance; nearest-neighbor resampling. For legacy skull-stripped images use positive-intensity mask. Evaluation segmentations never construct optimization masks.
preparation.label_interpolation: Nearest neighbor, background outside image; fixed per-pair label set from native annotations before fitting, never intersect with warped labels
preparation.map_format: Absolute RAS-mm pull coordinates, x-fastest, interleaved xyz, big-endian float64; validity separate uint8
preparation.preparation_changes: Future preprocessing candidates require development evidence and a new version before Q02; historical studies are never rewritten.

control.affine_policy: flashalign-within-modality-affine-recovery-v2: primary 100 linearizations/8 trials; one NoCaptureCandidateConverged-only recovery at 400/16
control.current_control: control-seal.json records actual source bytes and new provider revisions; it is not evidence-equivalent to the historical executable until replayed.

reference.initialization: Identical saved affine, affine fitting disabled, independently verify all 12 coefficients with four affinely independent points and image warp
reference.comparison_lanes: P02 audits existing reference and declares generous-convergence and matched-budget lanes on observed development data. Q02 freezes one strong audited primary reference; no qualification-outcome-based choice.
reference.invalid_reference: Report and penalize reference failures too; if fewer than 95% reference results satisfy the common gates, competitive qualification is inconclusive, not passed.

geometry.cell_region: All complete cells of each exported grid, eight corners and center, both directions
geometry.voxel_checks: Preserve current independent whole-grid finite-difference checks: no invalid/nonfinite/nonpositive interior Jacobians and brain minimum >= 0.05
geometry.residual_region: Current declared six-voxel interior; retain whole-field maxima separately
geometry.brain_region: Complete image-derived target brain mask; count invalid or out-of-domain samples in coverage denominator; no post hoc erosion
geometry.boundary_gate: R02 must additionally resolve and freeze the complete export-boundary contract, including original C04 failures, before G3/Q02; interior success cannot substitute. No validity masking or threshold relaxation.
geometry.interpretation: Finite sampled numerical evidence, not proof of a continuous diffeomorphism or analytic inverse

anatomy.expected_labels: P03 freezes common nonzero native labels per pair before fitting, records all absent/unscored labels and requires at least 90% of the cohort's declared label list in each native image; cohort label lists/harmonization are predeclared. Warped disappearance never changes denominator.
anatomy.dice: Arithmetic mean over expected labels per direction, then mean over the two directions; macro-average pairs within cohort and equally weight cohort means
anatomy.hd95: Per-label pooled bidirectional surface distances, 95th percentile with linear interpolation, 6-connected erosion boundary, Euclidean distances in mm; median over expected labels per direction, then mean over directions; macro-average pairs within cohort and equally weight cohort means
anatomy.missing_warped_label: Any expected label empty on either prepared target or warped source makes anatomy incomplete for that method/pair. Report label Dice=0 and missing HD95; primary pair receives failure penalties. Never impute perfect Dice for two empty masks.
anatomy.failure_rule: Any upstream failure, crash, timeout, rejected map, nonconverged run, fallback or incomplete anatomy receives pair Dice=0 and HD95=100 mm in primary analysis. Valid raw HD95 values are never capped. Store all raw diagnostics separately.
anatomy.supplementary: Complete-case comparisons, actual affine-fallback utility, per-label distributions, both individual directions, mean label HD95, landmarks/TRE and visual QA; no supplementary endpoint can rescue a failed primary gate.

acceptance.cohort_rule: Every cohort's point estimates satisfy the same 0.02 Dice/1.05 HD95 limits; report cohort intervals descriptively
acceptance.failure_tail_rule: At least 95% of all declared pairs satisfy Dice >= shared affine - 0.02 and HD95 <= shared affine + 0.5 mm; failed cases count against this fraction
acceptance.worst_decile_rule: For each method independently take bottom ceil(0.1*N) Dice and top ceil(0.1*N) HD95, retaining failure penalties; HalfFlow worst-decile means meet the margins. Report membership; no best-case filtering.
acceptance.convergence: A predeclared image-only convergence criterion must be satisfied on all required levels with native/independent admission. AcceptedStepBudget, AttemptBudget, ControllerExhausted, coarse-only completion and affine fallback are not convergence. O02/U01 must provide explicit truthful termination.
acceptance.all_exported_maps: Every result returned as accepted must satisfy every applicable native and independent geometry gate; a single falsely accepted result fails qualification even if overall reliability is >=95%.

uncertainty.method: Paired nonparametric bootstrap of subject-disjoint blocks, stratified within cohort; resample blocks with replacement, keep all subjects, pairs, directions and methods together. Recompute pair-weighted cohort means then equally weighted cohort mean on each replicate.
uncertainty.dice_pass: One-sided 95% lower percentile bound of mean(HalfFlow - reference) >= -0.02
uncertainty.hd95_pass: One-sided 95% upper percentile bound of ratio(mean HalfFlow HD95, mean reference HD95) <= 1.05; if reference denominator is zero, require zero candidate HD95 and report the degenerate comparison
uncertainty.affine_pass: One-sided 95% lower bound of mean Dice gain > 0 and upper bound of mean HD95 ratio < 1
uncertainty.report: Two-sided 95% percentile intervals for descriptive effects and success fractions, raw counts, number of subjects/blocks/cohorts. Point success >=95% does not imply a population lower confidence bound of 95%.
uncertainty.scope: Inference is conditional on the named cohorts and sampling design. With few cohort strata it does not establish performance in all sites/populations.
uncertainty.calibration: Before Q02, verify analysis code with null, correlated-within-block and missing-output simulations; failed coverage checks require a prospectively versioned analysis correction before holdout outcomes.

resources.timing: Native same-host executable, no overlapping jobs; include affine initialization, nonlinear fitting and required admission/export, exclude download/build and label-only evaluation; report each phase and peak process RSS. JVM warmup is measured separately and recorded.
resources.freeze: Record CPU/model/OS/RAM/toolchain/package versions and complete command in each receipt. P02 establishes measured baseline and U02 must meet this practical envelope before Q02. A prospective hardware change reruns both methods; post-outcome target relaxation is forbidden.

development.diagnostic_checkpoint_replays: Reported separately; no parameter selection from qualification labels/images
development.screen: First the three known sentinels plus three successes declared by D01; expand only under a written rule before results
development.old_gates: Preserve strict bidirectional Dice and median HD95 improvement over own affine in historical regression experiments; exact ties remain failed under that rule. New cohort qualification uses the separately declared statistical/tail gates and never rewrites old pass/fail labels.
development.change_control: Publish new immutable protocol/version and Mote rationale for any prequalification design change; retain superseded versions and negative experiments. After Q02 outcomes are inspected, any method or numerical-threshold change requires new independent confirmation.

handoffs.P02: Common geometry evaluator and strong reference selection on observed data
handoffs.P03: Actual independent cohort/subject/block manifest, license, labels and provenance audit
handoffs.D01: Checkpoint evidence on observed sentinels plus successes
handoffs.R02: Full-boundary inverse contract and numerical remedy
handoffs.Q02: Final executable, settings, independent cohort manifest, analysis implementation/calibration and hardware sealed before results
